text:
devon: Quick share — ran a KV cache occupancy sweep across regions, saw unusual p99 jump for slen 128-512 on EU-A100 when occupancy > 72%. Need eyes. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
sara: hmm, can you paste the exact command and a tiny snippet of the CSV?
devon: command: `./bench/run_kv_sweep --model=redwood-v2-small-q4 --slen-bins=8,32,128,512 --regions=us-eu --gpu-types=a100,h100 --occupancy-thresholds=50,60,70,80 --evict-policy=lrucap`
devon: csv head:
```
region,gpu,slen_bin,occupancy,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,throughput
EU,a100,128,68,12.4,45.2,210.3,320
EU,a100,256,74,14.1,55.0,482.9,180
US,h100,256,75,11.9,41.0,122.1,340
US,a100,256,74,13.8,50.2,135.7,190
```
liam: that p99(482ms) at slen 256 / occupancy 74% looks like paging/eviction storm. Did prefetcher warmup run?
devon: warmup was 30s steady feed, same as baseline. No explicit prefetch tweaks. evict thresholds default.
anya: could be kernel selection switching — on A100 we sometimes fall back to a slower matmul kernel when seq len crosses a boundary. Check logs for kernel hints. Also region network jitter can inflate p95/p99 when KV misses cascade.
bench-bot: new bench run uploaded: https://bench.redwood/2187654321/kv-occupancy-sweep (csv + plots)
sara: can you grep the runtime log for "kernel_switch" and "kv_page_fault" and post a couple lines? even a 3-line sample helps.
devon: grep output:
```
[12:03:11] kernel_switch: selected=matmul_fallback_v2 reason=seqlen=260
[12:03:12] kv_page_fault: key=0x7f3a.. count=1 latency_ms=3.1
[12:03:12] kv_eviction: evicted=24 occupancy_post=74
```
liam: eviction spike at same time as kernel fallback, likely batch processing got heterogeneous seq lens causing kernel to choose slower path. Suggest two experiments: 1) enforce kernel pinning for a100 for that run, 2) reduce max-batch for slen>=128.
sara: add occupancy-aware eviction: raise soft_threshold by 5% and extend grace window to 120s. Also try increasing warmup to 90s.
devon: scheduling both sweeps now. starting run (pin-kernel + warmup90) at 2187654400, will post interim p99s.
ops-bot: deploy note: pinned-kernel-image v3.4 rolled to eu-a100 pool at 2187654410 by deploy-ci :rocket:
devon: interim update (2187654600): pinned run p99 for EU,a100,256,occupancy74 -> 138.7ms (was 482.9). throughput steady at 185. warmup90 + eviction tweak also reduced variance. Looks promising.
sara: great, can you save the run as a candidate and run A/B traffic with production routing for 2h? add the eval prompt set for quality regressions too.
devon: done — candidate saved id=cand-2026-03-20-01, A/B scheduled. thanks all :thumbsup:
